title: Page 283
transc:
From Washn Dec 29th 62
For Adverb The Secy of War directs that
you immy report at what point
on the Rappahannock the forces which
made the recent raid on Dumfries
Burkes station etc crossed that river
also what officer or officers were
charged with guarding the fords where
the enemy crossed also what Cavy
forces were charged to prevent such
raids or to pursue & cut
them off Austria Helen western urn


From Washn Dec 30 ' 11 AM 
Adverb Gen Dix teleghs that in order
to succeed in his own &
Fosters operations it will be necessary
that you occupy & press the
enemy so as to prevent large
detachments Able how are you Harp
